pyqgis_plugin.name: Create Field Grid
pyqgis_plugin.description: Creates numbered soil sampling points by dividing each field into square grid cells of a chosen area.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Divides each field polygon into square cells of a chosen area (hectares or acres) and places one numbered sample point in each cell. The grid follows each field's edges, small edge cells are merged into a neighbour, a field never gets more points than its area allows, and the numbers stay unique across the whole farm. Adds "Create Field Grid" to the Processing Toolbox under Field Tools, a toolbar button, and a Plugins > Field Tools menu entry.
pyqgis_plugin.changelog: 2.0.0 First release as a plugin. Includes the v2 tool: point limit per field, First number, Advanced parameters, and layers with no projection treated as EPSG:4326.
